nar.text: The royal family was present with King Alphonso XIII of Spain and the Queen Victoria.
Thirteen cars line up in numerical order; the King's Hispano-Suiza leads the rolling start.

Divo's Delage jumped into the lead, closely followed by Masetti's Sunbeam and Benoist in another Delage.
They finished the first lap with Divo leading after 8m49s, 100 meters ahead of Masetti with another 100 meters to Benoist, then Costantini, P. di Vizcaya, Thomas and Torchy in the initial pack.
Goux pits and loses 10 minutes; Eldridge pits and retires with clutch and ignition trouble; Fouchet is out before the end of the lap.
